name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle, designed to travel on no more than three wheels at speeds over 35 mph, of a type required to meet the federal safety standards for motorcycles. Defined by Maryland Transportation Article §11-136.
restrictions: A seat or saddle, no more than three wheels on the ground, and designed to go faster than 35 mph
Of a type required to meet the federal motor vehicle safety standards for motorcycles; an off-road dirt bike that can't be registered as one is an off-highway recreational vehicle
Riders need a Class M driver's license, earned by experience or an approved basic motorcycle safety course
A rider on a motorcycle learner's permit may carry only a qualifying licensed supervisor
Every rider and passenger must wear an approved helmet, and the operator must wear approved eye protection unless it has a windscreen
Titled and registered as a Class D (motorcycle) vehicle, and must carry liability insurance
